# archipelago-hotels-mcp

A Go MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives Claude Desktop and compatible agents the ability to search, recommend, and visually display hotels from Archipelago Hotels & Resorts across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. It exposes four MCP tools backed by a central MySQL catalog and per-brand databases, fetches live room rates from the SimpleBooking XML API, and renders an interactive hotel dashboard as an embedded MCP App resource.

Supported brands: Aston, Grand Aston, The Alana, Harper, Hotel NEO, favehotels, Kamuela, Quest, Huxley, Nordic, Four Corners, PBA.

Transports: stdio (Claude Desktop, Pi Agent) and Streamable HTTP on :9011.

## Links

## Codebase

- `cmd/archipelago-hotels-mcp/` — Entry point. Parses `stdio`/`http` subcommands, wires DB pool and rate service.
- `internal/server/` — MCP server construction, tool registration, Gin HTTP handler with CORS, `/dashboard`, `/api/hotels`, `/api/brands`, `/api/regions`, `/health` endpoints.
- `internal/tools/` — Four MCP tool handlers: `search.go`, `recommend.go`, `detail.go`, `dashboard.go`.
- `internal/repository/` — MySQL data access layer. `repository.go` manages the `Pool` (central + lazy per-brand connections). `hotel.go` implements `SearchHotels`, `GetHotelByID`, `GetThumbnails`, `resizeImageURL`. `room.go` fetches room rows from brand DBs.
- `internal/rate/` — Rate orchestration. `rate.go` implements `Service.GetRates` with SimpleBooking → stored → starting_price fallback chain and a 5-minute in-memory cache. `simplebooking.go` posts to the SimpleBooking XML API. `cache.go` is the TTL cache. `sentec.go` is reserved for the Sentec REST API (not yet in use).
- `internal/resources/` — `dashboard.go` registers the MCP App resource URI. `mcp-app.html` is the embedded Vite-built interactive UI.
- `ui/` — Vite + TypeScript source for the MCP App dashboard. Built with `make build-ui`, output copied to `internal/resources/mcp-app.html`.

---

## Tool API Reference

### search_hotels

Search Archipelago hotels by city, country, brand, or free-text query. Returns up to 50 hotels with live pricing and thumbnail URLs.

**Input schema:**

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "city":    { "type": "string", "description": "City name (e.g. Jakarta, Bali, Yogyakarta)." },
    "country": { "type": "string", "description": "Country filter." },
    "brand":   { "type": "string", "description": "Brand filter (e.g. Aston, Harper, NEO)." },
    "query":   { "type": "string", "description": "Free-text search against hotel name and brand name." }
  }
}
```

All fields optional. Country defaults to `"Indonesia"` when omitted. Matching is case-insensitive LIKE on all supplied fields.

**Returns:** `searchResult`

```json
{
  "hotels":   [ /* hotelSummary[] */ ],
  "total":    42,
  "filtered": 12,
  "city":     "Bali",
  "country":  "Indonesia"
}
```

**MCP meta:** `ui.resourceUri` is set so Claude Desktop renders the result in the embedded dashboard. `ui.resourceDomains` allowlists `images.archipelagohotels.com` for thumbnails.

---

### recommend_hotel

Rank Archipelago hotels in a destination by vibe, budget tier, and trip purpose. Returns hotels sorted by score (highest first) plus a human-readable recommendation sentence.

**Input schema:**

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["destination"],
  "properties": {
    "destination": { "type": "string", "description": "Destination city or area." },
    "vibe":        { "type": "string", "description": "luxury | romantic | business | family | culture | nature | budget" },
    "budget":      { "type": "string", "description": "budget | midscale | upscale | luxury" },
    "purpose":     { "type": "string", "description": "leisure | business | honeymoon | family | solo" }
  }
}
```

**Budget price bands (IDR per night):**

| Tier      | Range              |
|-----------|--------------------|
| budget    | <= 500,000         |
| midscale  | 500,001–1,000,000  |
| upscale   | 1,000,001–2,500,000|
| luxury    | > 2,500,000 or 5-star |

**Returns:** `recommendResult`

```json
{
  "recommendation": "I found 8 Archipelago hotels in Bali matching a 'romantic' vibe. Top pick: Kamuela Villas Seminyak (Kamuela). romantic setting.",
  "hotels":      [ /* hotelSummary[], ranked by score */ ],
  "destination": "Bali",
  "vibe":        "romantic",
  "budget":      "upscale"
}
```

---

### find_hotels

Browse the full hotel portfolio with optional city/brand filters. Returns up to 200 hotels. Intended for "show all hotels" or "open the hotel list" requests.

**Input schema:**

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "city":  { "type": "string", "description": "City filter (optional)." },
    "brand": { "type": "string", "description": "Brand filter (optional)." }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** `dashboardData`

```json
{
  "filter":  "Jakarta",
  "hotels":  [ /* hotelSummary[] */ ],
  "total":   35,
  "match":   35,
  "message": "Showing 35 hotels in Jakarta"
}
```

---

### get_hotel_detail

Fetch full detail for a single hotel including all room types, live rates, address, and coordinates. Visibility is `"app"` — the dashboard UI calls it directly; it is hidden from Claude's tool picker.

**Input schema:**

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "required": ["hotelId"],
  "properties": {
    "hotelId": { "type": "string", "description": "Numeric hotel ID (central DB hotel_id as a string, e.g. \"42\")." }
  }
}
```

**Returns:** hotel detail object

```json
{
  "id":           "42",
  "name":         "Aston Sudirman Jakarta",
  "brand":        "Aston",
  "city":         "Jakarta",
  "country":      "Indonesia",
  "address":      "Jl. Jend. Sudirman ...",
  "rating":       8.7,
  "stars":        4,
  "latitude":     -6.2088,
  "longitude":    106.8456,
  "currency":     "IDR",
  "imageStyle":   "bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-800 to-sky-700",
  "brandColor":   "#003087",
  "thumbnail":    "https://images.archipelagohotels.com/...",
  "startingPrice": 850000,
  "roomTypes": [
    {
      "name":          "Deluxe Room",
      "pricePerNight": 850000,
      "baseRate":      750000,
      "currency":      "IDR",
      "maxGuests":     2,
      "rateSource":    "simplebooking"
    }
  ]
}
```

`roomTypes` is present only when rates are available from SimpleBooking or stored room data. `rateSource` is one of `"simplebooking"`, `"stored"`, or `"starting_price"`.

---

## Data Models

### HotelRow (internal/repository)

Central DB representation of a hotel.

| Field         | Type           | Notes                                              |
|---------------|----------------|----------------------------------------------------|
| HotelID       | int            | Primary key in `db_archipelagowebsite.tb_hotels`   |
| APIHotelID    | sql.NullInt64  | Per-brand DB hotel_id; nil if not mapped           |
| BrandID       | int            | FK to `tb_brands`                                  |
| BrandName     | string         | e.g. `"Aston"`, `"favehotels"`                    |
| DBPrefix      | string         | Per-brand DB prefix, e.g. `"aston"`, `"favehotel"` |
| RegionName    | string         | City/region from `tb_region`                       |
| Name          | string         | Hotel display name                                 |
| Address       | string         | Street address                                     |
| Rating        | float64        | Guest rating 0–10                                  |
| Stars         | int            | Derived: rating>=9→5, >=8→4, >=7→3, >=6→2, else 1 |
| Latitude      | float64        |                                                    |
| Longitude     | float64        |                                                    |
| StartingPrice | float64        | Fallback price from central DB                     |
| Currency      | string         | e.g. `"IDR"`                                       |
| ImageStyle    | string         | Tailwind gradient class for card backgrounds       |
| BrandColor    | string         | Hex brand color from `tb_brands`                   |

### RoomRate (internal/rate)

Single room's pricing from any source.

| Field        | Type    | Notes                                        |
|--------------|---------|----------------------------------------------|
| Name         | string  | Room type name                               |
| RatePerNight | float64 | Total per night including tax                |
| BaseRate     | float64 | Pre-discount rate (SimpleBooking only)       |
| Source       | string  | `"simplebooking"` | `"stored"` | `"starting_price"` |

### SearchParams (internal/repository)

| Field   | Type   | Notes                         |
|---------|--------|-------------------------------|
| City    | string | Matched against region_name and hotel_address |
| Country | string | Matched against region_name; ignored when "Indonesia" |
| Brand   | string | Matched against brand_name    |
| Query   | string | Matched against hotel_name and brand_name |
| Limit   | int    | 0 = unlimited                 |
| Offset  | int    | Pagination offset              |

### hotelSummary (tools layer — returned by all tools)

| Field      | Type     | Notes                            |
|------------|----------|----------------------------------|
| id         | string   | Central DB hotel_id as string    |
| name       | string   |                                  |
| brand      | string   |                                  |
| city       | string   | region_name                      |
| country    | string   |                                  |
| rating     | float64  |                                  |
| stars      | int      |                                  |
| priceFrom  | float64  | Best available rate, or starting_price |
| currency   | string   |                                  |
| imageStyle | string   | Tailwind gradient class          |
| brandColor | string   | Hex color                        |
| thumbnail  | string   | Resized CDN URL or empty         |
| tags       | []string | Heuristic: beach/city, business, resort, premium |

---

## Environment Variables

| Variable           | Default                               | Description                                                   |
|--------------------|---------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|
| `MYSQL_HOST`       | `127.0.0.1`                           | MySQL host for the central DB                                 |
| `MYSQL_PORT`       | `3306`                                | MySQL port                                                    |
| `MYSQL_USER`       | `root`                                | MySQL username                                                |
| `MYSQL_PASS`       | _(empty)_                             | MySQL password                                                |
| `MYSQL_DB`         | `db_archipelagowebsite`               | Central database name                                         |
| `url_image_resizer`| `https://images.archipelagohotels.com/` | Base URL for the Archipelago image resizer proxy             |
| `DEBUG`            | _(unset)_                             | Set to `1` to enable debug-level structured logging to stderr |

Per-brand databases are accessed on the same host/port/user/pass as the central DB. Database names follow the pattern `db_{prefix}website` (e.g. `db_astonwebsite`), with exceptions: `favehotel` → `db_favewebsite`, `pba` → `db_pba`.

---

## Architecture Summary

```
Claude Desktop / Agent
        |
        | MCP (stdio or Streamable HTTP :9011)
        v
  archipelago-hotels-mcp (Go binary)
        |
        |-- tools/search.go        search_hotels
        |-- tools/recommend.go     recommend_hotel
        |-- tools/dashboard.go     find_hotels
        |-- tools/detail.go        get_hotel_detail (app-only)
        |
        |-- repository/Pool
        |     |-- central MySQL    db_archipelagowebsite
        |     |     tb_hotels, tb_brands, tb_region
        |     |
        |     \-- per-brand MySQL  db_{prefix}website  (lazy connect)
        |           tb_hotels (thumbnail_desktop)
        |           tb_hrooms / tb_hroom (room_rate)
        |           tb_websetup (booking credentials)
        |
        \-- rate/Service
              |-- SimpleBooking XML API  (live, with circuit breaker + 5min cache)
              |-- stored tb_hrooms.room_rate  (fallback)
              \-- hotel_starting_price from central DB  (last resort)
```

The MCP App resource (`archipelago://hotels-dashboard`) is an embedded Vite-built HTML file. Claude Desktop renders it in an iframe alongside tool results. The iframe calls `/api/hotels`, `/api/brands`, `/api/regions`, and `get_hotel_detail` (via MCP) for its data.

---

## Rate Fallback Logic

`rate.Service.GetRates(ctx, dbPrefix, apiHotelID, checkIn, checkOut)` proceeds:

1. **Cache check** — 5-minute TTL keyed on `dbPrefix:apiHotelID`. Hit returns immediately.
2. **SimpleBooking live API** — Loads `BrandCredentials` from `tb_websetup` in the brand DB. Calls `https://xml.simplebooking.it/xmlservice.asmx/HotelAvailRQ` with the hotel's XML credentials. A circuit breaker (5 failures → 120 s cooldown) prevents thundering-herd retries. On success, caches and returns `RoomRate[]` with `Source: "simplebooking"`.
3. **Stored rates fallback** — Queries `tb_hrooms.room_rate` (or `tb_hroom` depending on brand schema) for pre-loaded rates. Returns `RoomRate[]` with `Source: "stored"`.
4. **No rates** — Returns nil. Callers then use `HotelRow.StartingPrice` from the central DB, labelled `Source: "starting_price"`.

`BatchMinRates` fetches rates for a slice of hotels in parallel using a bounded goroutine pool (max 5 workers). It returns `map[hotelID]float64` of minimum rates, falling back to `StartingPrice` per hotel when no live or stored rates exist.

`checkIn`/`checkOut` are `YYYY-MM-DD`. If empty, they default to today and tomorrow.

---

## Image URL Transform Logic

`resizeImageURL(img, width, height, location)` in `internal/repository/hotel.go`:

1. Extracts the subdomain from the CDN URL using a regex.
2. Maps `sentineltech.*` → bucket `sentineltech-publicwebsite`; all others use the second URL segment as the bucket name.
3. Builds a new URL using the `url_image_resizer` base (default `https://images.archipelagohotels.com/`).
4. Appends resize query parameters:
   - width=0, height=0 → no resize params (original dimensions)
   - width only → `?s={width}&location={location}`
   - both → `?d={width}x{height}&location={location}`

`GetThumbnails` calls this for every hotel's `thumbnail_desktop` field. Width and height are both 0 (no resize), so thumbnails are served at original CDN size via the resizer proxy.

---

## Build Commands

```bash
# Full build: Vite UI + Go binary
make build

# Go binary only (uses existing internal/resources/mcp-app.html)
make build-go
# or
go build -o bin/archipelago-hotels-mcp ./cmd/archipelago-hotels-mcp

# Install to GOPATH/bin
make install
# or
go install ./cmd/archipelago-hotels-mcp

# Run stdio transport
make run-stdio
# or
bin/archipelago-hotels-mcp stdio

# Run HTTP transport with debug logging on :9011
make dev-http
# or
bin/archipelago-hotels-mcp http -addr :9011 -verbose

# Lint
make lint
# or
go vet ./...

# Clean
make clean
```

The `ui/` Vite build requires Node.js and npm. The binary embeds `internal/resources/mcp-app.html` at compile time; `make build-fast` skips the UI build when the HTML file is already present.

---

## Common Patterns for Agents

**Search hotels in a city:**
```
Tool: search_hotels
Input: { "city": "Bali" }
```

**Recommend luxury hotels for a honeymoon:**
```
Tool: recommend_hotel
Input: { "destination": "Bali", "vibe": "romantic", "budget": "luxury", "purpose": "honeymoon" }
```

**Browse all hotels (open dashboard):**
```
Tool: find_hotels
Input: {}
```

**Filter dashboard by brand:**
```
Tool: find_hotels
Input: { "brand": "Harper" }
```

**Get full hotel detail with room rates:**
```
Tool: get_hotel_detail
Input: { "hotelId": "42" }
```
Note: `get_hotel_detail` visibility is `"app"` — it is intended to be called by the embedded dashboard UI, not directly by agents in Claude's tool list.

**Degraded mode:** The server starts even when the MySQL central DB is unreachable. All tool calls will return errors in that state. The `/health` endpoint returns `{ "status": "degraded", "db": false }`.

**Rate currency:** All prices are in the hotel's native currency (nearly always `IDR` — Indonesian Rupiah). No conversion is performed.

**Hotel ID format:** The `hotelId` parameter for `get_hotel_detail` is the central DB `hotel_id` as a decimal string (e.g. `"42"`), not a slug. Tools return this as the `id` field in `hotelSummary`.
